subtitle: Lesson 46 · Monitoring for Performance

eyebrow: The free alternative: a table + a procedure
code:
CREATE TABLE dba.PerfLog (
  LogID INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  CapturedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL
    DEFAULT SYSDATETIME(),
  MetricName NVARCHAR(128),
  MetricValue BIGINT
);
caption: Plus a procedure: one row per DMV counter, inserted every run.

code:
-- A second job step, on its
-- own schedule:
DELETE FROM dba.PerfLog
WHERE CapturedAt <
  DATEADD(DAY, -60, SYSDATETIME());

-- 60 days: enough history to
-- compare Mondays to Mondays,
-- short enough to stay bounded.
caption: Capture without cleanup just grows a new performance problem.
